title: Kagamine Len — Putting Feelings Into Action〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow, a school with a starry sky...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm? Is someone playing music?
Let's go see what's up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... I thought I heard it coming from one of these classrooms...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wah! Oh... Heya, Len!
When did you get here?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We've actually been wondering when you'd show up, so it's nice to see you here so soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. Why don't you come in?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, if you don't mind.
Oh, can you tell me about the ones who made this place?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So the ones who made this place are in a band too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! They're even trying to go pro together! What do you think? Isn't it awesome?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You seem really proud of them, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So what if I am?!
We're all friends, so it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We also play a lot of music together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh? But won't your excitement overpower them and not let them play the way they want?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, completely!
I'll make a bet with you if you still don't believe me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Miku and Luka were helping me with some special guitar training just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So we're gonna have a guitar battle!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, this one's pretty nice.
It's so easy to strum. Whoever tuned this did a really good job.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But what kind of battle are we doing, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A really simple one! We'll take turns playing riffs and whoever can't play their opponent's riff loses!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be the judges for your contest, as well as the judges of whether or not Rin's improved.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're the one who suggested this, so why not you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grr... I started off easy because I wanted to have a little fun with you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I said that I've been training with Miku-P and Luka, right? Anyway, my turn!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I can't wait to see how this turns out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, I think it's about time we wrapped this up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Uh oh... That seemed pretty hard...
B-But I have to show them how far I've come!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That was so exciting.
You did really well, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had that last one! I know I can play it! But I still need more practice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe. You really were doing great, but your fingering during that last one sort of fell apart.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But thank you so much, Miku-P, Luka! You too, Len! Thanks for agreeing to this!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Quite a welcome party, wouldn't you say?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I appreciate it, but is she gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, she is the anxious type, but despite her outward personality, she takes music very seriously.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In time, I hope that you get to see how she helps the girls move forward instead of holding them back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I get it. I mean, the battle we did just now was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And it's clear that she's incredibly hard-working and doesn't give up easily.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad you're here with us now, Len.
